<teammate-message teammate_id="team-lead">
{"type":"task_assignment","taskId":"2","subject":"2단계: 설정 및 Decorator 연결 (outbound-adapter/proxy)","description":"outbound-adapter/proxy 모듈에 캐시 설정과 4개의 Caching Decorator를 구현한다.

## 전제 조건
- Task 1 (캐시 엔진)이 완료되어야 함

## 작업 1: build.gradle.kts 수정
outbound-adapter/proxy/build.gradle.kts에 캐시 모듈 의존성 추가:
```kotlin
implementation(project(":outbound:repository:cache"))
```

## 작업 2: ProxyCacheProperties.kt (패키지: com.cowave.search.outbound_adapter.proxy.cache)
```kotlin
@ConfigurationProperties(prefix = "proxy.cache")
data class ProxyCacheProperties(
    val l1: L1Config = L1Config(),
    val l2: L2Config = L2Config(),
    val entity: EntityConfig = EntityConfig(),
) {
    data class L1Config(
        val defaultTtlMinutes: Long = 30,
        val maxSize: Long = 10000,
    )
    data class L2Config(
        val defaultTtlMinutes: Long = 60,
    )
    data class EntityConfig(
        val category: EntityCacheConfig = EntityCacheConfig(keyPrefix = "platform-search.index.category.cache"),
        val brand: EntityCacheConfig = EntityCacheConfig(keyPrefix = "platform-search.index.brand.cache"),
        val manufacturer: EntityCacheConfig = EntityCacheConfig(keyPrefix = "platform-search.index.manufacturer.cache"),
        val mall: EntityCacheConfig = EntityCacheConfig(keyPrefix = "platform-search.index.mall.cache"),
    )
    data class EntityCacheConfig(
        val keyPrefix: String,
        val l1TtlMinutes: Long? = null,
        val l2TtlMinutes: Long? = null,
    )
}
```

## 작업 3: ProxyCacheConfig.kt (패키지: com.cowave.search.outbound_adapter.proxy.cache)
@Configuration으로 4개 엔티티(Category, Brand, Manufacturer, Mall)에 대한 TieredCache 빈 생성
각각 CaffeineLocalCache + ValkeyRemoteCache + TieredCacheImpl 조립
ObjectMapper는 Spring 제공 빈 주입, RedisTemplate도 기존 빈 주입

## 작업 4: 기존 RepositoryImpl 수정
4개 파일에 @Component → @Component("graphqlXxxRepository") 변경:
- CategoryRepositoryImpl.kt → @Component("graphqlCategoryRepository")
- BrandRepositoryImpl.kt → @Component("graphqlBrandRepository")
- ManufacturerRepositoryImpl.kt → @Component("graphqlManufacturerRepository")
- MallRepositoryImpl.kt → @Component("graphqlMallRepository")

## 작업 5: 4개 Caching Decorator 생성 (패키지: com.cowave.search.outbound_adapter.proxy.cache)

### CachingCategoryRepository.kt
@Primary @Component, CategoryRepository 구현, TieredCache<Int, Category> 주입
idExtractor = { it.id }, 기존 graphqlCategoryRepository를 @Qualifier로 delegate 주입

### CachingBrandRepository.kt
@Primary @Component, BrandRepository 구현, TieredCache<Long, Brand> 주입
idExtractor = { it.id }

### CachingManufacturerRepository.kt
@Primary @Component, ManufacturerRepository 구현, TieredCache<Long, Manufacturer> 주입
idExtractor = { it.id }

### CachingMallRepository.kt
@Primary @Component, MallRepository 구현, TieredCache<Int, Mall> 주입
idExtractor = { it.mallId } (Mall은 id가 아니라 mallId 프로퍼티 사용!)

## 작업 6: YAML 설정 추가
bootstrap/dynamic-indexer/src/main/resources/application-outbound.yml에 proxy.cache 설정 추가

## 도메인 모델 정보
- Category(id: Int, name: String, depth: Int, idPath: String, namePath: String, status: String) — computed properties 있음
- Brand(id: Long, name: String)
- Manufacturer(id: Long, name: String)
- Mall(mallId: Int, mallUseYnDanawa: String?, mallUseYnEnuri: String?, mallIdDanawa: String?) — id 필드가 mallId임!

## Repository 인터페이스
- CategoryRepository.findAllByIds(categoryIds: List<Int>): List<Category>
- BrandRepository.findAllByIds(brandIds: List<Long>): List<Brand>
- ManufacturerRepository.findAllByIds(manufacturerIds: List<Long>): List<Manufacturer>
- MallRepository.findAllByIds(mallIds: List<Int>): List<Mall>

## 프로젝트 규칙
- 패키지명: com.cowave.search.outbound_adapter.proxy (언더스코어)
- 로거: `private val log by logger()` (com.cowave.shared.utils.logger)

package com.cowave.search.domain.proxy.category

data class Category(
    val id: Int,
    val name: String,
    val depth: Int,
    val idPath: String,
    val namePath: String,
    val status: String,
) {
    val isActiveCategory: Boolean = status.uppercase() == "USE"

    private val ids: List<String> = idPath.split("|").map { it.trim() }
    private val names: List<String> = namePath.split("|").map { it.trim() }

    val categoryId1: Int = ids[0].toInt()
    val categoryId2: Int? = ids.getOrNull(1)?.toInt()
    val categoryId3: Int? = ids.getOrNull(2)?.toInt()
    val categoryId4: Int? = ids.getOrNull(3)?.toInt()

    val categoryName1: String = names[0]
    val categoryName2: String? = names.getOrNull(1)
    val categoryName3: String? = names.getOrNull(2)
    val categoryName4: String? = names.getOrNull(3)

    val categoryNames: String = names.joinToString(DELIMITER)

    companion object {
        private const val DELIMITER = " "
    }
}

package com.cowave.search.outbound_adapter.proxy.cache

import org.springframework.boot.context.properties.ConfigurationProperties

@ConfigurationProperties(prefix = "proxy.cache")
data class ProxyCacheProperties(
    val l1: L1Config = L1Config(),
    val l2: L2Config = L2Config(),
    val entity: EntityConfig = EntityConfig(),
) {
    data class L1Config(
        val defaultTtlMinutes: Long = 30,
        val maxSize: Long = 10000,
    )

    data class L2Config(
        val defaultTtlMinutes: Long = 60,
    )

    data class EntityConfig(
        val category: EntityCacheConfig = EntityCacheConfig(keyPrefix = "platform-search.index.category.cache"),
        val brand: EntityCacheConfig = EntityCacheConfig(keyPrefix = "platform-search.index.brand.cache"),
        val manufacturer: EntityCacheConfig = EntityCacheConfig(keyPrefix = "platform-search.index.manufacturer.cache"),
        val mall: EntityCacheConfig = EntityCacheConfig(keyPrefix = "platform-search.index.mall.cache"),
    )

    data class EntityCacheConfig(
        val keyPrefix: String,
        val l1TtlMinutes: Long? = null,
        val l2TtlMinutes: Long? = null,

package com.cowave.search.outbound_adapter.proxy.cache

import org.springframework.boot.context.properties.ConfigurationProperties

@ConfigurationProperties(prefix = "proxy.cache")
data class ProxyCacheProperties(
    val l1: L1Config = L1Config(),
    val l2: L2Config = L2Config(),
    val entity: EntityConfig = EntityConfig(),
) {
    data class L1Config(
        val defaultTtlMinutes: Long = 30,
        val maxSize: Long = 10000,
    )

    data class L2Config(
        val defaultTtlMinutes: Long = 60,
    )

    data class EntityConfig(
        val category: EntityCacheConfig = EntityCacheConfig(keyPrefix = "platform-search.index.category.cache"),
        val brand: EntityCacheConfig = EntityCacheConfig(keyPrefix = "platform-search.index.brand.cache"),
        val manufacturer: EntityCacheConfig = EntityCacheConfig(keyPrefix = "platform-search.index.manufacturer.cache"),
        val mall: EntityCacheConfig = EntityCacheConfig(keyPrefix = "platform-search.index.mall.cache"),
    )

    data class EntityCacheConfig(
        val keyPrefix: String,
        val l1TtlMinutes: Long? = null,
        val l2TtlMinutes: Long? = null,
    )
}
